# FINAKI

> FINAKI is an independent design studio founded by Imran Shiundu (Nairobi, 2022). We build change-making websites and brand experiences for founder-led brands whose presence hasn't caught up to what they've built. Nairobi / Melbourne — working worldwide.

- Contact: imran@finaki.co.ke
- Founder: Imran Shiundu
- Founded: 2022
- Locations: Nairobi (Kenya), Melbourne (Australia) — serving clients worldwide
- Services: Brand Strategy, Visual Identity, Website Strategy, Website Design, Webflow Development, 3D Development
- Clients: Vinamilk, Mộc Châu, The University of Sydney, OH Architecture, Supersolid, Mammoth Murals, HISS, Backhouse
- Results: $2M+ in new projects for OH Architecture within 3 months of launch; 58% average session duration increase for Supersolid; $100K+ in new work for Mammoth Murals within 30 days of launch; 15+ universities united on a single platform for HISS
- Recognition: Awwwards Site of the Day ×3, FWA of the Day ×2, CSSDA Website of the Day ×4
- Process: 01 Uncover your story → 02 Shape your digital presence → 03 Send it into the world
- Pricing: Fixed, outcome-scoped proposals — one number covering strategy, design and development
- Contact style: Email only — imran@finaki.co.ke, read by Imran, answered within 24 hours. No forms, no gatekeepers.
- Pages: Home (https://finaki.co.ke/), About (https://finaki.co.ke/about), Portfolio (https://finaki.co.ke/portfolio), Services (https://finaki.co.ke/services), FAQs (https://finaki.co.ke/faq), Contact (https://finaki.co.ke/contact)
